messages:
Priya: dropping a new mock — trying a "stack-aware" legend for stacked-area charts. idea: each legend row shows series color, short label, and a small stacked total badge. when panels are narrow we collapse labels and keep the badge + color so totals remain readable.

Ethan: makes sense. curious about unit toggles: some teams want bytes shown as 'MiB' vs 'MB' and an explicit convert control in the legend could help. maybe a small dropdown chevron next to the total badge.

Cass: UX concern: adding controls in legend increases hit targets. we should keep tap targets >=44px on mobile. propose chevron opens a popover with unit options and a "convert all" checkbox.

Ravi: outlier handling idea: allow "clip to percentile" by default but show a faint dashed line representing clipped values. hovering the series (or tapping the legend) temporarily restores raw values as an overlay. that preserves context without exploding y-axis.

Priya: sketch of the collapsed legend state: 
```
[■] RQ · 1.2k  [▾]
[■] Errors · 4  
[■] CPU  · 73% 
```
where ▾ opens unit/format controls, and the middle column is the compact total.

Ethan: accessibility nit: ensure the compact total has aria-label with full text, e.g., aria-label="Request rate, 1200 requests" and the chevron is reachable by keyboard. also announce when values are clipped: "values clipped above 99th percentile".

Cass: copy options for clipping status: 
- "Clipped (≥99th pct)"
- "Max shown (click to view raw)"
Which reads clearer? I lean to first for brevity.

Ravi: implementation notes — prefer not to re-scale the main canvas when toggling the clip overlay. draw overlay as separate canvas layer so we can fade it in/out. also keep snapshot tests for clipped and unclipped states.

Priya: micro-interaction: when user hovers the total badge we show a mini tooltip with 3 quick stats (sum, mean, peak). small sparkline allowed inside tooltip (width 56px). ensure sparkline color meets contrast.

Ethan: performance check: precompute totals at query time if possible. avoid recomputing on every hover. also stable IDs: legend items keyed by series_id so preferences persist.

Cass: mobile behavior: collapsed legend becomes a horizontal scroller with swipe to see hidden series, long-press on a series row opens actions (mute, pin, inspect). add haptic feedback hint in spec.

design-bot: preview deployed for branch `legend/stack-toggle` — https://staging.redwood.run/pr/3621. visual snapshots created for: full, collapsed, clipped-overlay.

Priya: action items: 1) Cass — finalize mobile scroller interactions + copy. 2) Ethan — aria-label examples + stable id plan. 3) Ravi — canvas overlay sketch + cost/perf note. I'll iterate mocks with the stacked-total badge and the clip dashed-line treatment. thanks! :raised_hands:
